\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
% Isolate the feedback/return leg of the CircuitikZ op-amp tutorial.
\begin{circuitikz}
  \path[use as bounding box] (-.2,-.7) rectangle (3,3.4);
  \draw (1,3) -- ++(0,-1) coordinate[label=left:FB] (FB)
    to[R=$R_1$] ++(0,-2) coordinate[pground] (PE)
    -- ++(1,0) coordinate (RET);
  \draw[blue] (FB) -- ++(1.5,0);
  \draw[red] (PE) -- ++(-.8,0);
  \draw[teal] (RET) -- ++(0,.6);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
